name: Godot Mod Loader
description: For Godot 4.1 to 4.3. Installs the loader for the user, keeps mods as zips and runs its setup when Vortex starts the game.

features: Installs Godot Mod Loader for you: it downloads the release set in `src/gml/constants.ts`, checks it against the SHA-256 GitHub publishes, and copies its `addons` folder next to the game's executable.

Installs mods the way Godot Mod Loader loads them: as zips in the `mods` folder. Extracted mods are zipped again as `<namespace>-<name>.zip`, and archives that hold mod zips install those zips unchanged.
Starts the game with Godot Mod Loader's setup when you start it from Vortex, so mods keep working after game updates.
Deletes the loader's caches after every deployment, after purging and after game updates, so it rebuilds them for your current mods and game version.
notes: `GML_RELEASE` in `src/gml/constants.ts` is the Godot Mod Loader release the extension installs. v7.0.1 supports Godot 4.1 to 4.3, so check the [releases](https://github.com/GodotModding/godot-mod-loader/releases) if {{gameName}} uses another version.
